description: Pretest a short video (mp4, mov, webm; max 512 MB, 10 minutes) against a synthetic audience: hook score, attention curve, drop-off points. Uploads the file (video_path on this machine, or video_url), splits it into scenes, then returns status 'needs_price_confirmation' with the quote. The quote exists only after preparing, and the draft is free EXCEPT speech-to-text: when you pass no transcript_srt, preparing charges 0.25 to 6 simulation sessions for transcription up front. Analysis cost is personas x 5 + scenes x 0.5 sessions, minimum 10, max 60 personas. Nothing more is spent until you re-call with accept_sessions >= the quote (pass it up front to skip the pause). If preparing is still running the tool returns 'preparing' with experiment_id, video_id and prepare_job_id: call again with those. Collect with aetherya_get_result kind 'video_analysis'. Results are simulated, not real-user data.

accept_sessions.description: Sessions you accept to spend; must cover the quote.

hook_windows.description: Split scenes into hook windows so the opening seconds are scored on their own. Default true.

persona_ids.description: Persona ids, instead of an audience group.

segments.description: Limit an audience group to these segment ids.

transcript_srt.description: SRT transcript; skips the speech-to-text charge.

video_url.description: http(s) link to a video file.

name: aetherya_pretest_video
title: Pretest a video
